title: By the Sea
note: b383 — first use of 'sea_day' (a full sea band below the horizon, distinct from 'pond_day'), 'dune', 'sandwich', 'teacup', 'book_prop', 'wave' and 'crab' in a scene. The reveal page (1) and closing page (9) put the 'dune' prop in the foreground at the bottom of the frame so the sea can fill most of the canvas above and behind it.

pages.brief: Pip and Ned arriving at the top of a dune with the whole sea opening up in front of them. Big sky, big water, two small figures — deliberately small and distant, a wide reveal of the view, not of them.
pages.alt: Pip and Ned arrive at the top of a dune with the whole sea opening up in front of them, two small figures against a big sky and big water.

pages.brief: Ned's orange feet in clear shallow water at the shoreline, seen close and from above, small waves breaking over them. Cool greens and blues.
pages.alt: Close on Ned's orange feet in clear shallow water at the shoreline, a small wave breaking over them in cool greens and blues.

pages.brief: Ned working through an enormous picnic — a wrapped sandwich bigger than his head — with total commitment. Comic appetite.
pages.alt: Ned works through an enormous picnic, a wrapped sandwich bigger than his own head, with total commitment.

pages.brief: Pip with a small cup of tea balanced on a flat rock, one wing round it, very civilised. Steam rising. Gentle contrast with the previous page.
pages.alt: Pip sits with a small cup of tea balanced on a flat rock, one wing around it, very civilised, with steam rising.

pages.brief: The two of them sitting side by side on the sand looking out to sea, backs to the reader, small against the horizon — deliberately wide and distant. Quiet and companionable.
pages.alt: Pip and Ned sit side by side on the sand looking out to sea, small and quiet against the wide horizon.

pages.brief: Ned lying on his front reading a book propped in the sand, feet swinging in the air behind. Utterly absorbed.
pages.alt: Ned lies on his front reading a book propped up in the sand, utterly absorbed, feet in the air behind him.

pages.brief: A crab scuttling sideways out of the sand with one claw raised; Ned already airborne in retreat, book flying. Peak comedy.
pages.alt: A crab scuttles sideways out of the sand with one claw raised, as Ned leaps airborne in retreat, his book flying.

pages.brief: Wide beach scene at golden hour, long shadows, the tide coming in over their footprints. Warm and nostalgic.
pages.alt: A wide beach scene at golden hour, long shadows reaching across the sand as the tide comes in over their footprints.

pages.brief: Closing page: the pair walking back up the dune at sunset, sandy, tired, Ned still holding the book. Sea glowing orange behind them.
pages.alt: Closing page: Pip and Ned walk back up the dune at sunset, sandy and tired, Ned still holding his book, the sea glowing orange behind them.
